comment delete_current_object Deletes the object at object_cursor: unlinks it (fixing first_object and last_object), object_count - 1, pushes its block on free_object_stack (current_object = it, push_free_object) and moves object_cursor back to the previous object, so run_objects goes on with the right next one.
comment delete_if_off_screen Deletes the current object and its children (delete_object_and_children, deleted = 1) when screen_x leaves -0xC0..0x200 or screen_y leaves -0xC0..0x1A0; deleted = 0 otherwise.
comment delete_next_object Unused: delete_object of the object after the current one (its next).
comment delete_object Deletes object: unlinks it (fixing first_object and last_object), object_count - 1, and pushes its block on free_object_stack; free_count is the new count and previous the object before it. object_cursor is left alone.
comment delete_object_and_children The default handler (init_object_fields): frees the current object's child chain (pool 1 children with delete_object, pool 2 ones with free_object_2), then delete_current_object; deleted = 1. Halts in int_default if free_object_stack_2's count goes past 0x100.
comment delete_object_outside_loop delete_object for code outside run_objects: reloads free_objects, first_object and last_object first, and stores first_object and last_object back into first/last_object_address after.
comment direction_to_object The current object's direction = the angle (angle_of_vector) to the object at r14 in projected coordinates; hands back angle_of_vector's octant.
comment direction_to_speed speed_x = sine_table[direction] * speed >> 6 and speed_y = -(cosine_table[direction] * speed >> 6), with direction taken & 0x3FF.
comment distance_to_object nearest_player_distance = the distance from the current object to the object at r14 (square_root of dx * dx + dy * dy, projected coordinates), also handed back.
comment distance_xy_to_object distance_x = |dx| and distance_y = |dy| (whole x and y) from the current object to the object at r14, also kept in distance_to_player_1 and distance_to_player_2.
comment draw_child_shadow Places the current object's shadow (its pool 2 child) on its floor, at projected_x and projected_y + floor_z with the sprite offsets, palette 0x9FFE, queued at its screen_y - 0x10. With flag 0x10: palette 0x87A0, drawn every other frame (shadow_blink), and on the skipped frames current_object is left at the shadow.
comment drop_rings Releases rings_to_release rings from object_cursor, one scatter_rings_random ring at a time: at its position, heading released_ring_angle at speed 0x60 (spread at random with released_rings_random), each 0x10 frames after the last (released_ring_wait); released_ring_flip marks their palettes. It never checks that a ring was made.
comment explode_object Turns the current object into the big explosion: explosion_frames 0x1F-0x2B, palette 0x86D0, handler explosion_animate; sound 7.
comment explode_object_medium Unused: sets explosion frames 0xF-0x1F, palette 0x82A0 and handler explosion_animate, then runs on into explode_object, which puts frames 0x1F-0x2B and palette 0x86D0 over them (and plays sound 7).
comment explosion_animate An explosion: unproject_object, the next explosion_frames frame every other frame until last_frame, then removed (delete_object_and_children); drawn every frame (queue_sprite).
comment face_nearest_player Distance and angle (square_root, angle_of_vector) to each player in play, players 3, 2, 1, into the per-player and nearest_player variables. Its direction then becomes the last angle worked out plus direction_to_player_offsets[nearest_player], an offset (0x1C-0x20) rather than that player's angle, so it does not face the nearest player.
comment face_object The current object's direction = the angle to the object at r14 (projected coordinates), then distance_to_object, whose distance it hands back.
comment fall_to_floor Gravity for the current object: speed_z + 0x6000 each frame z is not floor_z, and when z + speed_z would reach floor_z it lands (z = floor_z, speed_z 0); z itself is moved elsewhere. height = floor_z - z (0 on the floor); over_pit = 1 when floor_z_int is 0x800 or more.
comment find_nearest_player_x nearest_player_distance = the smallest |player x - x| (whole x) over the three players, in the game or not.
comment free_object_2 Pushes object back on free_object_stack_2 (pool 2 blocks are never linked into the list).
comment group_leader_move An invisible marker leading a group along its row (direction 0/4 +y, 1 -y, 2 +x, 3 -x) by its group_leader_data entries (group_leader_read_script, group_leader_move_step); the members fall as it passes. It holds back (base_speed 0) in stage 8 in game modes 0x17 and 0x1D, or while no_player_in_play, player_mishap or player_dropping_in.
comment group_leader_move_step project_object, then chaser_speed: base_speed while screen_x is past screen_threshold, else the camera's ground speed * catch_up_factor / 0x100, at least base_speed (which also ends a hold-back, as do 0x300 scroll units or hold_timer running out); the leader moves by it along its direction unless waiting (wait_timer) or grey_screen_active.
comment group_leader_read_script The leader's wait_timer counts down; then, once scroll_position reaches its next group_leader_data entry, the entry gives screen_threshold, catch_up_factor, base_speed and wait_timer (a negative catch-up factor ends the path and removes the leader). Then group_leader_move_step.
comment group_leader_wait Holds a new group leader: leader 0 (sprite_frame 0) until group_leader_0_held is clear, the others until group_leaders_1_3_held is; then handler group_leader_move.
comment init_object init_object_fields with mode 0: the whole object.
comment init_object_2 init_object_fields with mode 1: only the first 0x30 bytes, the size of a pool 2 block.
comment init_object_fields Clears an object for use: draw_next 0, sprite_flags 4, sprite_frame and sprite_palette 0, sprite_scale 0x100, the layer, screen position, hitbox, anchor and size 0, handler = delete_object_and_children, direction and projected_x/projected_y 0. With mode 0 also flags and init_object_fields_tail; previous, next, parent and child are kept.
comment init_object_fields_tail speed_x, speed_y and speed_z = 0; unless mode is 2 (clear_object_speeds), also z and every field after it up to next_handler.
comment is_floor_block_off_screen Unused: 0 when the current object's floor_block (low half) is one of nearby_floor_blocks, the floor blocks near the screen, else 0xFFFFFFFF (also when there are none).
comment is_off_screen 0xFFFFFFFF when the current object is more than 0x20 outside the 0x140 x 0xE0 screen (screen_x + 0x20 >= 0x180 or screen_y + 0x20 >= 0x120, unsigned), else 0.
comment is_off_screen_margin is_off_screen with margin_x and margin_y in place of 0x20.
comment is_on_screen 1 while screen_x is within -0xC0..0x200 and screen_y within -0xC0..0x1A0 (delete_if_off_screen's bounds), else 0.
comment link_object Links object at the end of the circular list, between last_object and first_object (previous and next), makes it last_object (and last_object_address) and adds 1 to object_count.
comment move_object_projected Moves the current object in projected space: speed_x adds up in projected_x_carry, whose whole pixels go to projected_x; projected_y + speed_y, z + speed_z; then unproject_object (x and y, the floor, the screen position).

comment next_random Two steps through the random number area at 0xD80000: random_position moves on by the word it points at (within 0x80000) and the word at the new place is taken. random_value hands back the two words, the first in the low half.
comment place_sprite_at_cursor_floor The current object's screen position = object_cursor's, moved down to object_cursor's floor (floor_z - z): the place for its shadow. Hands back 0xFF, the bucket drawn first (under everything).
comment place_sprite_near_cursor The current object's screen_x and screen_y = object_cursor's + offset_x and offset_y.
comment push_free_object Pushes current_object's block on free_object_stack (count + 1, the entry on top).
comment released_ring_bounce A released ring that can be collected, for lifetime frames: with flag 0x20 its direction turns by 0x300 (speeds cleared for the frame); touched (flag 4) it plays sound 0x13 and is removed, unless its toucher is a player in state 0xD or 0x20 with hurt_contact_delay. Else released_ring_move; at the end it goes on as scattered_ring_vanish.
comment released_ring_move Moves a released ring (move_object_projected, fall_to_floor): on landing it bounces up again at bounce_speed - bounce_speed / 4 + 0x10000, and in the air animation_frame gains 3 a frame. comment released_ring_start A released ring that cannot be collected yet: released_ring_move for pickup_delay frames, then it clears flag 0x200 and goes on as released_ring_bounce.

comment reset_linked_objects_flag electric_fence_state = 0 when a game starts (fence_post_init sets 1, flame_machine_remove 0xFF; fence_post_update switches on it).
comment reset_object_list Empties the object list: first/last_object_address = 0x200000, object_count 0, and free_object_stack holds all 0x80 blocks of 0xA0 bytes (offsets 0x0000-0x4F60 from 0x200000).

comment reset_object_pool_2_alt Unused: reset_object_pool_2 with 0x1D8 blocks of 0x34 bytes (0x205000-0x20AFE0).
comment reset_objects Empties the object list and both pools (reset_object_list, reset_object_pool_2); the run_objects after it finds no objects and only reloads free_objects. Called when the game mode changes.
comment reset_objects_alt Unused: reset_objects with reset_object_pool_2_alt for the second pool.
comment run_objects Runs every object once: from the one after last_object round to last_object, object_cursor and current_object = each and its handler is called (call_code); a handler that deletes its object moves object_cursor back. Then first/last_object_address take first_object and last_object. Nothing when object_count is 0.
comment spawn_debris Throws count debris pieces (spawn_objects, handler debris_fly) from the current object: each at its position, palette 0x8300, thrown up at a random speed_z, with random extra zoom, direction and speed on top of the object's own, debris_frames 0-9 or (odd random) 0xA-0x13.
comment spawn_group_leader Spawns group leader n (the record's first byte & 3), kept in group_leaders[n]: sprite_frame = n, the record's x, y, z (floor_z = z), direction and path in group_leader_data, handler group_leader_move (group_leader_wait while group_leader_0_held or group_leaders_1_3_held). spawned 0xFFFFFFFF, or 0 when no object is free.

comment game_mode_event_0D Game mode 0xD, stage 8's event at scroll 0: the players frozen (players_frozen, event_0d_active) for 0xB4 frames (scene_timer), then the scroll runs at speed 0x1C; with the stage frame going on (no zones), at scroll_position 0xA00 game_mode 3, the players free and scroll mode 7.
comment game_mode_event_0F Game mode 0xF, which no code or stage event sets: by scene_step event_0f_start (also for step 3), event_0f_stop_scroll, event_0f_show_messages; then the scroll, tiles, restart point, spawn_walls and the hit, wall and platform checks.
comment game_mode_event_10 Game mode 0x10, stage 6's opening scene (the first of a game): by scene_step, the opening objects and update_stage_06_background for 0x1A4 frames (background step 3 at 0x168; the colour offsets down 1 every 8 frames from 0xF0 to 0x12B), then background step 5, the offsets reset and 0x12C frames of lightning (spawn_stage_06_lightning); then game_mode 2.
comment game_mode_event_12 Game mode 0x12, stage 9's event at scroll 0x4C00: event_12_stage_frame until scroll_position 0x80B1, where the scroll stops (scroll_mode 1) until every player is out of play or done drifting (drift_done); then a sign (kind 0xF at 0x644, 0x149E), event_12_fast_scroll cleared, scroll mode 7 and game_mode 3, run at once.
comment game_mode_event_13 Game mode 0x13, stage 9's event at scroll 0: the scroll held (scroll_mode 1) for 0x78 frames (scene_timer) while update_screen_wipe opens the screen, then scroll mode 0; event_12_stage_frame every frame, and from scroll_position 0x16AC game_mode 3, run at once.
comment game_mode_event_14 Game mode 0x14, stage 9's event at scroll 0x1800, the scroll stopped: once a player is in play and none in state 0x25 has yet to bounce (sequence_bounced), it spawns an icicle dropper and Eggman's speech, and 0x12C frames later scroll mode 7 and game_mode 3; a sign (kind 0xE) at scene_timer 0x3C. The stage frame; game over with no player left.
comment game_mode_event_15 Game mode 0x15, stage 3's event at scroll 0xA360: the stage frame with the scroll stopped (scroll_mode 1) until check_stage_clear changes game_mode (run at once); game over with no player left.
comment game_mode_event_16 Game mode 0x16, stage 3's event at scroll 0x1B80 and 0x8610: the stage frame without the scroll or tile updates until scroll_resume_request is set, then scroll mode 7 and game_mode 3; game over with no player left.
comment game_mode_event_18 Game mode 0x18, the last stage's (0x11) event at scroll 0: the ending (update_ending).
comment game_mode_event_19 Game mode 0x19, stage 0x10's event at scroll 0xC80: update_player_summary (game over with no player left); a player in play whose x passes 0x17C sets barred_gate_closing; then event_19_check_rope_bridge.
comment game_mode_event_1A Game mode 0x1A, stage 8's event at scroll 0x3100: set up on scene_step 0, then each event_1a_scroll_script entry gives the scroll its mode and speed once scroll_position reaches its position (an 0xFFFF one: once seesaw_launched is set and scene_timer runs out). The stage frame; game over with no player left; at scroll 0x6080 game_mode 3, scroll mode 7, speed 5.
comment game_mode_event_1C Game mode 0x1C, stage 8's riding event at scroll 0x7A8D: by scene_step event_1c_follow (steps 0, 1 and 4), event_1c_stop, event_1c_scroll; the stage frame; game over with no player left; at scroll_position 0x84A0 game_mode 3 at scroll speed 5, and bridge_0_plank_count 0.
comment game_mode_event_1F Game mode 0x1F, stage 0xB's escape at scroll 0xF00: start_escape_countdown once; the stage frame after check_stage_clear (game over with no player left); with escape_started the alarm (flash, shake, sounds 0xF and 0x7C, 0x7C again at 0x30C); the countdown runs until all have finished (the swap loop marks player 1's byte for player 3); at escape_seconds 0 YOU FAILED (0x20).
comment game_mode_game_over Game mode 7, game over: on its first frame sounds 0x94 and 0x73 (0x76 on stage 0x11) and cabinet_events 0x1F; then the GAME OVER banner (its text after the ending) with the contacts running; from 0x78 frames back to the attract screens (game_in_progress 0, blending and colour offsets off). A start with enough credits begins a new game.
comment game_mode_intro Game mode 1, the intro at a game's start (stage 7, how to play): set up once (stage_init_flags bit 13: contact lists and camera cleared, view at start section 6, map, goal, floors, spawns, palette, stage_start_sounds[stage]); then the stage frame without zones, until a player in play presses the button or game_mode_timer reaches 0x21C: game_mode 2.
comment game_mode_play_stage Game modes 3, 5 and 6, a frame of play: update_player_summary (on stage 0xB in a game it also closes joining, once); with no player left game_mode 7; then check_stage_clear, the grey screen, the scroll, tiles, floors, restart point, spawners and contacts, and run_stage_events. When game_mode changes it runs the new mode at once.
comment game_mode_screen_wipe Game mode 0x11, the first event of stages 3, 4, 0xA, 0xC and 0x10: the stage frame (the scroll held on stage 4) while update_screen_wipe opens the screen's windows, then game_mode 3 once edges_done shows all four edges in place (0xF).
comment game_mode_stage_change_fade Game mode 0x1E (check_stage_clear on stages 0xB-0xF): fades to black (update_fade) with the stage frame going on, then starts the next stage (start_stage) and fades it in from black (game_mode_timer -1) before game_mode 3; on stage 0x11 it goes to game_mode 3 straight after start_stage. The layers' colour offsets are on during the fades.
comment game_mode_stage_clear Game mode 0x17, a stage cleared: once, stage_clear_timer 0x14A and two banners, the stage's name (stage_name_banners[stage], stage_clear_banner_reveal) and CLEARED (cleared_banner_wait), with sounds 0x94 and 0x7B; banner_break from timer 0x78. The stage frame goes on; when the timer runs out, the results (game_mode 0x1D).
comment game_mode_stage_end_fade Game mode 4, between stages: on its first frame sounds 0x95 and 3; clears mixer_blend bit 11 (the blending), runs the island map screen (run_map_screen, map_screen_active set every frame) and starts the next stage (game_mode 2) once map_screen_step reaches 5. Hands back run_map_screen's bottom_speed.
comment game_mode_stage_results Game mode 0x1D, the stage's results: once, game_mode_timer 0x1E0 and the ring tally (start_ring_tally); the stage frame goes on until stage_results_done is set, then game_mode 4 (the map screen).
comment game_mode_stage_select Game mode 8, the debug stage select (only the unused check_stage_select_buttons sets it): once, stage 3, its texts, and video RAM from 0xE000 cleared; player 1's trackball steps stage through 0-0x11, drawn at text cell (24, 21); start 1 takes cleared_stages from stage_select_cleared_values[stage] and starts it (game_mode 2, stage_start_kind 1).
comment game_mode_start_game Game modes 0 and 0x21, starting a game or a demo: the screen and the player blocks cleared, player_status 0 (the spare byte 0xFF), the player objects started. A game (game_in_progress) clears cleared_stages and game_frames, current_screen 6, and goes to character select (game_mode 0x1B); a demo takes stage from demo_input and starts it (game_mode 2, stage_start_kind 0xFF).
comment game_mode_you_failed Game mode 0x20, YOU FAILED (from the stage 0xB escape): once, sound 0x94 and the colour offsets on; they rise to 0x1F (white) a step every 4 frames while the stage frame runs without the scroll; then game_mode_timer counts: sound 0x85 at 2, the YOU FAILED text from 0x78, you_failed_done at 0x12C; game_mode 7 once no player is left.
comment load_stage_map_pointers Points current_restart_point, floor_blocks and floor_block_bounds at stage's lists (stage_restart_points, stage_floor_blocks, stage_floor_block_bounds); hands back the bounds' table_offset and bounds_list.
comment read_trackball_step Adds player_number's trackball x motion to trackball_step_sums (restarting the sum when the direction changes) and hands back in player_number a step: 1 each 0x40 counts one way, -1 the other, else 0; trackball comes back as the address of the trackball's motion.
comment reset_objects_from_list Empties the object list and pools (reset_objects), then starts an object per handler of the list in object_handler_list (a count, then handlers), walking the player blocks (player_block_cursor): player_start_stage becomes player_join for a player who is_joining, or player_resume when its player_status is 1, 2 or 3. Stops when no object is free.
comment reset_trackball_step Clears trackball_step_sums[player_number] and reads the trackball once (read_trackball_step): the start of the debug stage select.
comment run_game_mode One frame of the game: runs the mode game_mode names (0x21, past the table, runs game_mode_start_game too). A mode that changes game_mode runs the new one in the same frame (run_game_mode again).
comment run_stage_events The stage's events: once scroll_position reaches the next (scroll position, game mode) record of stage_events[stage], it switches game_mode to it (scene_step and scene_timer 0), unless the scroll is already 0x100 or more past it (stage 0x11 takes it anyway); the cursor moves on either way.
comment spawn_banner_sparkle Spawns a ring sparkle (ring_sparkle_animation, palette 0x81B0, handler banner_sparkle_animate) offset_x along the banner from its screen position.
comment stage_clear_banner_hold A shown stage clear banner: queued at depth 0xFF until banner_break; then sound 0x1B and it splits into letters (banner_letter_spin): itself and new objects, as many as its animation's first word (banner_letters_left), 0x10 apart from 8 past its x, each with its number in kind, odd ones y-flipped (temp_1 is banner_letters_left).
comment stage_clear_banner_reveal Reveals a stage clear banner a step at a time (its animation), a sparkle 0x10 further along at each step (spawn_banner_sparkle, sparkle_offset); at the last step it holds (stage_clear_banner_hold) and sets stage_name_shown, or cleared_shown for the CLEARED banner (flags bit 0).
comment start_player_objects Starts the player objects afresh: reset_objects_from_list with player_objects (player_1_start to player_3_start and the three shadows). Hands back handler_cursor.
comment start_player_objects_alt Restarts the player objects for a stage: reset_objects_from_list with player_objects_alt (player_start_stage for each player, which it turns into player_resume or player_join as their blocks say, and the three shadows). Hands back player_number.
comment start_stage Game mode 2, a stage starts: cleared_stages + 1 (at most 0xE) if stage_start_kind is 0, player objects restarted unless it is negative, contact lists and stage state cleared; blending, view (a demo's start section from demo_input), map, goal, floors, spawns, stage_start_sounds[stage], palette; game_mode 3. In a game, cabinet_events 0x15 (0x14 when cleared_stages - 2 is odd).
comment update_grey_screen The grey screen while a player asks for it: with grey_screen_request set in any player block, grey_screen_active and mixer_offset_select bits 1-4 are set; when none asks any more they are cleared and grey_screen_ended is set for that one frame.
comment update_player_summary Sums up the players: player_dropping_in while a player_status is 0x81 (scroll_mode 0 meanwhile, then saved_scroll_mode back), no_player_in_play when no status has bit 7, player_mishap when a player still in has its mishap_flag (all three cleared), players_in_play (also in in_play_count). With skip_player_summary set it only clears the three flags.
comment update_restart_point Moves current_restart_point on through the stage's 8-byte restart records to the first whose scroll position is past scroll_position; hands back position, its low half now scroll_position.
comment advance_attract_screen Moves the attract mode to its next screen: attract_step + 1 (wrapping after 8), system_mode = attract_sequence[attract_step], system_mode_step 0.
comment attract_demo_1 System mode 4, the first demo: once, current_screen 4, game_mode 0, demo_input at attract_demo_1_inputs and attract_timer -0x240; then the game runs (run_game_mode) on the recorded inputs until attract_timer reaches 0, and the next attract screen follows.
comment attract_demo_2 System mode 5, the second demo: as attract_demo_1, with current_screen 5 and attract_demo_2_inputs.
comment attract_ranking System mode 2, the ranking: once, screen mode 0, the text layer, page 0 and the objects cleared, start_ranking_display and current_screen 2; the next attract screen once ranking_done is set.
comment attract_title System mode 3, the title: once, the display off for 2 frames, screen mode 0, the text layer and the objects cleared, the title's state reset and current_screen 3; then every frame the (C) SEGA 1992 line and run_title_screen, until title_done sends it on to the next attract screen.
comment attract_warning System mode 0, the warning screen after power-on: step 0 sets attract_timer -0x258, turns the display off for 3 frames, loads the font, video registers and sprites, screen mode 1 (wide), init_sound, and prints warning_screen_text; step 1 waits for attract_timer (wait_attract_timer); step 2 goes on to the next attract screen.
comment boot Power-on: the vector table base, eight byte pairs to 0xE00000 (unmapped on this board) and the interrupt controller's set-up to 0xD00000, the privileged stack pointers 0x20FE00, a delay; then for ever: init_system, frames (wait_for_frame, run_frame) until test_mode is set, test mode while it lasts, then over again from system mode 3, the title.
comment clear_work_ram Zeroes the work RAM from 0x208000 to 0x20FDFF (0xFC blocks of 0x80 bytes), keeping system_mode_and_step.
comment count_frames_and_check_test_switch From irq_vblank_start outside test mode: power_on_frames + 1 (carrying into power_on_frames_high), saved to the bookkeeping and its backup copy every 64 frames; game_frames + 1; test_mode set when the test switch or the board's test button (inputs_pressed bits 1, 13) is pressed without service (bit 0).
comment delay_after_reset An empty loop of 0x8000 passes that boot runs before the first init_system.
comment init_game_settings The game's settings at init_system: cabinet_config from setting_cabinet_config, game_in_progress, demo_prompt_shown and joining_closed 0, the ranking loaded (load_ranking, whose result it hands back) and stage_order copied to stage_order_copy (0x11 halfwords).
comment init_io_ports Sets the I/O chip up: port D 0x10, ports G and H 0, CNT 0x80, direction 0xC8 (D, G and H as outputs), then D, G and H again; cabinet_events 0x1F.
comment init_mixer Loads the mixer: 0x28 halfwords of defaults into the mixer registers, and their last 0x10 into the mixer shadows from mixer_text_blend, which irq_vblank_start copies out every frame.
comment init_system Sets the machine up, at power-on and after test mode: interrupts off, work RAM cleared, the I/O ports, the frame and system state, sound, settings and bookkeeping, mixer, palettes, sprites, font, video registers and objects, three read_controls, the interrupt controller acknowledged, check_moving_seat_dip and init_game_settings; interrupts back on.
comment int_default The handler of 247 of the 256 vector table entries: four halts, then on into int_vector_02 (four more halts, then run_vblank_copies).
comment int_vector_02 Vector 2, the NMI: four halts, then run_vblank_copies, which follows it in the program; int_default runs into it.
comment irq_sound The sound interrupt (vector 0x42): only acknowledges it (0xFB to irq_acknowledge).
comment irq_timer0 Timer 0's interrupt (vector 0x43): timer_0_ticks + 1 (nothing reads it), the timer reloaded with 0x32, acknowledged (0xF7 to irq_acknowledge).
comment irq_timer1 Timer 1's interrupt (vector 0x44): timer_1_ticks + 1 (nothing reads it), the timer reloaded with 0x23, acknowledged (0xEF to irq_acknowledge).
comment irq_vblank_end The vblank end interrupt (vector 0x41): runs vblank_hook (the sprite buffer swap) unless debug_pause is set, counts frames_to_wait down for wait_for_frame, and acknowledges (0xFD to irq_acknowledge).
comment irq_vblank_start The vblank interrupt (vector 0x40): the mixer shadows out to the mixer, the pending vblank copies, vblank_start_hook, a sound command (send_sound_command); outside test mode count_frames_and_check_test_switch and, unless free_play, update_coins; display_off_frames counts down and at 0 turns the display back on (io_cnt bit 1); acknowledged, vblank_counter + 1.
comment pause_on_start_3 Unused: a debug pause on start 3 (inputs_pressed bit 7): debug_pause + 1 (no vblank_hook), then frames go by (wait_for_frame, attract_timer held still) until start 3 is pressed again; debug_pause - 1.
comment play_demo_buttons In a demo (current_screen 4 or 5, current_game_mode 3, no game in progress): puts the 3 low bits of the byte at demo_input into bits 25-27 of inputs, the demo players' buttons, and moves demo_input on by one. Hands back inputs.
comment play_demo_trackballs In a demo (current_screen 4 or 5, current_game_mode 3, no game in progress): the next 6 signed bytes at demo_input become trackball_1_x to trackball_3_y, and demo_input moves past them.
comment read_controls Reads the controls: ports B, A, F, E as one word (B on top) through play_demo_buttons into input_ports and input_ports_active, inputs_pressed and inputs_released from the change (active low); the six trackball counts into trackball_1_x to trackball_3_y (one beyond +-0x60 keeps the last), the counters cleared, x negated; play_demo_trackballs.
comment read_service_inputs Unused: ports F and E (service, test, coins, starts and the board's switches) as one halfword in service_inputs, the last one in service_inputs_previous, with service_inputs_pressed and service_inputs_released from the change (active low): read_controls' edges on 16 bits.
comment reset The V60's reset vector: jumps to boot.
comment run_frame A frame of boot's loop: frame_counter + 1; outside system modes 0 and 6 the attract credits, and a start (a player's button with setting_no_start_buttons) pressed with enough credits for cabinet_config starts the game (run_frame_start_game; configs 2 and 3 through run_frame_check_p2_start); else system_mode's handler, run_objects, build_sprite_list, draw_queued_strings.
comment run_frame_check_p2_start The start check of run_frame for the individual coin chutes (cabinet_config 2, and 3 after player 3's start): player 2's start (bit 5; player 2's button, bit 0x18, with setting_no_start_buttons) with enough p2_credits, or player 1's (bit 4 or 0x10) with p1_credits, starts the game (run_frame_start_game); else the system mode's handler and the rest of the frame.
comment run_frame_start_game A start pressed with credits: system_mode 6 (the game), game_mode 0, system_mode_step 0, game_in_progress 0xFF; then the rest of the frame: run_game_mode, run_objects, build_sprite_list, draw_queued_strings.
comment run_vblank_copies Runs the copies queued for vblank: for each of the vblank_copy_count entries of vblank_copies (source, dest, halfwords) the source block is copied to dest and on after it as many times as dest's top byte says; vblank_copy_count and vblank_copies_pending are cleared.
comment send_sound_command Sends one queued sound a frame (irq_vblank_start): the next id of sound_queue (32 entries) is looked up in sound_commands and its two bytes written to the sound CPU's mailbox, sound_command_group and sound_command.
comment split_frame_count Splits a frame count (frames_high:frames, a bookkeeping time) into days (/ 0x4E9FA0), hours (/ 0x346A7), minutes (/ 0xDFB) and seconds (/ 0x3C), each from the last remainder: the first three divisors take 59.64 frames a second, the last 60.
comment system_mode_idle System mode 1, which attract_sequence never holds: only clears system_mode_step.
comment wait_attract_timer System mode 7, and step 1 of attract_warning: once attract_timer reaches 0, system_mode_step + 1 and frame_counter 0.
comment wait_for_frame Waits for the next frame: sets sprite_list_ready, polls until irq_vblank_end has counted frames_to_wait below 0, reloads it from frames_per_wait, points sprite_list_start_offset at the sprite back buffer, attract_timer + 1, and reads the controls (read_controls), handing back what that hands back.
comment wait_for_frames Sets frames_to_wait = frames_per_wait, then wait_for_frame; frames_per_wait is 0 (only the unused init_sprites_swapping_every_frame sets 1), so it waits one frame. Hands back wait_for_frame's count.
comment angle_of_vector The angle (0-0x3FF) of the vector dx, dy, handed back in dx: the smaller of |dx| and |dy| over the larger (times 0x100) picks a byte of angle_ratios, added to the base angle angle_octants gives for the signs and the larger axis (taken from ~entry when the entry is negative); octant gets the entry.
comment convert_64_to_bcd Unused: the 64-bit number number_high:number_low in BCD, 24 digits: two divisions by 10 make each byte, written backwards below stack_pointer and padded with zeros, then read back most significant first into bcd_high, number_high and number_low.
comment convert_from_bcd Unused: hands back the number the 8 BCD digits of value stand for, from the top digit down (times 10 plus each nibble).
comment convert_to_bcd value becomes its BCD, up to 8 digits: each division by 10 puts the remainder in the top nibble and shifts the rest down, and a shorter number is rotated into place. digit keeps the last remainder (past 8 digits, the low byte of what is left, in BCD).
comment find_floor The floor under the current object, from the nearby_floor_blocks block holding its x, y: floor_block, floor_type, floor_attribute, then find_floor_set_floor_z (none: find_floor_no_block); on a platform (flags bit 3) its block and z. The old real floor goes to previous_floor_block and previous_floor_z.
comment find_floor_block_at_point Unused: hands back the floor block of nearby_floor_blocks whose box holds the point x, y, or no_floor_block when none does (floor_blocks + 2 when no block is nearby).
comment find_floor_no_block find_floor when no nearby block holds the object: floor_block = -1 (a real floor is first kept in previous_floor_block and previous_floor_z), and floor_z and floor_slope from no_floor_block through find_floor_set_floor_z.
comment find_floor_set_floor_z floor_z = the height of block (whole pixels), floor_slope = its slope; on a slope floor_z adds (y - y_min, or x - x_min when the floor_slopes record has bit 1) >> 12, rounded, times the slope's factor >> 4.
comment find_nearby_floor_blocks Lists in nearby_floor_blocks (count in nearby_floor_block_count) the floor blocks with one of the four points of their floor_block_bounds in the area view_x - 0x80 .. + 0x1C0, view_y - 0x80 .. + 0x160 (the bounds' extremes are tested first). Nothing while nearby_floor_blocks_locked.
comment get_floor_z_at_point Unused: find_floor's floor z for any point: block = the nearby_floor_blocks block whose box holds x, y (no_floor_block when none), floor_z = its height << 16 plus, on a slope, (y - y_min, or x - x_min) >> 16 times the floor_slopes factor. With no block nearby floor_z is left alone.
comment point_to_screen The screen position of a projected point: screen_x = projected_x - view_x, screen_y = (projected_y + z) >> 16 - view_y, which projected_y also gets.
comment polar_to_xy angle becomes dx = sine_table[angle] * length >> 6 and length becomes dy = -(cosine_table[angle] * length >> 6); cos_part keeps the cosine product.
comment project_object The current object's isometric screen point: projected_x = ((x + y) >> 8) * 0xB5 >> 16, projected_y = ((y - x) >> 9) * 0xB5 (16.16; 0xB5 / 0x100 is cos 45 degrees), then update_screen_position.
comment project_object_2 project_object with update_screen_position written in, except that once scroll_position reaches 0xA5F0 screen_y takes current_player's own_view_y in place of view_y.
comment project_point The screen position of the map point point_x, point_y at height z: projected as in project_object, then point_to_screen; point_x and point_y become its screen x and y, projected_y the screen y too.
comment screen_point_to_ground The map x, y under the screen point point_x, point_y at height z: adds view_x and view_y, takes z off y, doubles it and unprojects (unproject_point) into point_x and point_y.
comment set_speed_from_direction speed_x = sine_table[direction] * speed_int >> 6 and speed_y = -(cosine_table[direction] * speed_int >> 6): speed (its whole part) along direction. Hands back the cosine product.
comment set_speed_from_player_speed set_speed_from_direction with current_player's ground_speed_int as the speed.
comment side_of_box sides = where the current object's x, y lies around the box of other: 8 before it in x, 4 past it, 2 before it in y, 1 past it (0 inside). hitbox_offset_y gets other's.
comment square_root value becomes its integer square root, two bits of value a round for 16 rounds (steps_left counts them down to 0).
comment unproject_point The inverse of project_object: from a projected x and twice the projected y (16.16), point_x = ((point_x - point_y) >> 8) * 0xB5 and point_y = ((point_y + point_x) >> 8) * 0xB5, the map x and y.
comment update_screen_position screen_x = projected_x - view_x + sprite_offset_x and screen_y = (projected_y + z) >> 16 - view_y + sprite_offset_y; screen_y comes back too.
comment add_step_screen_offset Adds the dx, dy step_offset points at (an animation step's, after its frame word) to screen_x and screen_y, negated by the x and y flips (sprite_flags bits 6 and 7).
comment animate Counts animation_timer down; when it runs out it reloads it from animation_speed and moves to the next step (animate_step). wrapped and at_last_step come back FF when the step wrapped round or is the last.
comment animate_all_parts animate for a multi-part sprite: on each new step (backwards with flags bit 7, wrapping) the step's frame is written into every part of part_list. at_last_step is FF on the last step; part ends past the last part.
comment animate_and_move animate with steps of frame, dx, dy: on each new step sprite_frame takes the frame and projected_x and projected_y_int move by dx, dy (negated by the flips). Hands back at_last_step FF on the last step.
comment animate_around_anchor The same steps of frame, dx, dy, but placing the object at anchor_x, anchor_y plus dx, dy (set_step_around_anchor). Hands back FFFFFFFF on the last step.
comment animate_part_list The animation timer of a sprite whose steps are part lists: when animation_timer runs out it reloads from animation_speed and animate_part_list_step moves on.
comment animate_part_list_step animate_step for multi-part sprites: animation_frame moves on (backwards with flags bit 7, wrapping) and part_list = the animation's address plus the step's word, the next part list.
comment animate_step animation_frame + 1 (- 1 with flags bit 7) and sprite_frame = that step's word. Past the last step (its number is the animation's first word) it wraps to 0 (going back, to the last) with wrapped FF; reaching the last step (0 going back) sets at_last_step FF. frame is the new step.
comment animate_step_with_flags The next step of an animation of two-word steps, always forwards: its flags word goes into sprite_flags in place of the flips (bits 6-7) and its frame into sprite_frame. at_last_step is FF on the last step.
comment animate_with_flags The animation timer (animation_timer, reloaded from animation_speed when it runs out), then animate_step_with_flags.
comment animate_with_screen_offset animate with steps of frame, dx, dy whose dx, dy are added to screen_x and screen_y (add_step_screen_offset); between steps the current step's offset is added again (apply_step_screen_offset). Hands back at_last_step FF on the last step.
comment apply_step_screen_offset Adds the current animation step's dx, dy to screen_x and screen_y again, without moving on (animate_with_screen_offset between steps).
comment build_sprite_list Writes the sprite list from sprite_list_start, emptying the depth buckets from 0xFF (drawn first) to 0: an entry per object, by sprite_flags bits 15/14/12: a scaled or unscaled frame, the object's own 16 bytes (clips), a jump, a sized frame, or one per part (over 16 parts: int_default).

comment add_coin Counts a coin: bookkeeping_chute + 1, a pulse more pending at pending_offset for the coin counter. Hands back coin_credits plus those.
comment add_service_credit Gives credit_block a service credit unless it already has max_credits: changed flag, credits + 1, service_coin_sounds + 1, and its coins and bonus_coins cleared when it reaches the maximum. Hands back service_credits + 1, or unchanged when full.
comment add_to_credit_pool Unused: unless free_play, adds credits_to_add to credit_pool, at most 9 (credit_pool_coins cleared at the cap), and copies it to bookkeeping_coin_credits and bookkeeping_backup around update_bookkeeping_checksum. comment load_text_font Sets up the text layer: video_text_control 0x1F7 (map at 0x31F000, characters at 0x31C000), copies 0x9A0 halfwords of text_font into the characters, expands the 0x5B 1-bit characters that follow it in color 1 (expand_font) and clears the text map.
comment print_formatted_text Unused: prints a formatted text: a position halfword (0x310000 | it), an attribute byte, then runs of characters ending in 0, each followed by a code: 0 ends, 3/6/9 go on at 1, 2 or 3 cells a character, 0xC a new attribute, 0xF/0x15/0x1B a new position and attribute and 0x12/0x18/0x1E a new attribute at width 1, 2 or 3, 0x21/0x24 skip cells.

comment queue_string Adds a string to string_queue (x, y, palette, scale, text) for draw_queued_strings to draw with sprites; mode 0 instead takes x, y, palette and scale from the record at x and the text after them. Ignored once 0x2B strings are queued.
comment queue_string_at Queues the string text at screen x, y with palette and scale (queue_string, mode 1).
comment queue_string_record Queues the string of a record at record: x, y, palette, scale, then the characters (queue_string, mode 0), as the GAME OVER banner does; the y and scale passed in are not used.
comment apply_video_registers The VBLANK hook: writes video_registers_latched to the chip's registers 0x31FF10-0x31FF4F and video_layer_opaque_latched to video_layer_opaque_flags, then latches the shadows from nbg0_scroll_x on (scroll, centres, pages) for the next VBLANK: the chip gets them a frame later.
comment clear_blocks Writes count blocks of 16 zero bytes from dest; hands back dest past them.
comment clear_page_0_and_scroll Zeroes the first 0x400 bytes of video RAM (0x300000) and the 0x80 bytes of scroll and register shadows from nbg0_scroll_x.
comment copy_blocks Copies count blocks of 16 bytes from source to dest; hands back both past them.
comment copy_palette_block Copies size bytes of colors from source to dest in palette RAM (move_string, by halfwords); hands back both past them.
comment copy_palettes_with_pen_0 Writes 16-color palettes at dest from size bytes of source colors: pen 0 is pen_0_color, pens 1-15 the next 15 colors of the source.
comment empty_vblank_hook Unused: an empty function, the vblank_start_hook init_video_registers_layers_off installs.
comment erase_vram_script Unused: walks a VRAM script like run_vram_script but writes 0 (cell) to every cell it would draw, skipping the data; the address, skip and page-clear commands work as there, and 0xAA ends.
comment erase_vram_script_bytes Unused: command 0x8F erased: a count byte, then the high byte and count bytes skipped; cell count times.
comment erase_vram_script_end Unused: command 0xAA's routine, which ends an erase_vram_script; erase_vram_script returns by itself on it, so this is an empty function.
comment erase_vram_script_fill Unused: commands 0x86, 0x89 and 0x8C erased: a count byte, the word skipped; cell count times.
comment erase_vram_script_fill_down Unused: command 0x9B erased: a count byte, the word skipped; cell count times down a column, 0x40 bytes apart.
comment erase_vram_script_fill_down_wide Unused: command 0x9E erased: cell count times down a column of a 64-cell map, 0x80 bytes apart.
comment erase_vram_script_fill_up Unused: command 0xA1 erased: cell count times up a column, 0x40 bytes apart.
comment erase_vram_script_repeat Unused: command 0xA4 erased: cell count times to the same cell; hands back script past the command.
comment erase_vram_script_words Unused: commands 0x92 and 0x95 erased: a count byte, the count words skipped (0x95's dictionary is left alone); cell count times.
comment fill_halfwords Writes value into count halfwords from dest; hands back dest past them.
comment init_video_registers Sets up the video chip: vblank_start_hook = apply_video_registers; from video_control, 0x00-0x0F from video_register_defaults, 0x10-0x4F cleared, the zoom steps 0x50-0x5B 0x200, 0x5C-0x5F from the defaults, five clip rectangles 0,0-0x13F,0xDF, 0x88-0x8F from the defaults; then set_screen_mode(0) and clear_page_0_and_scroll.
comment init_video_registers_layers_off Unused: init_video_registers, then the four tile layers off (video_layer_disable | 0xF) and empty_vblank_hook as vblank_start_hook, so the register shadows would never reach the chip.
comment load_default_palettes Empties the VBLANK copies (vblank_copies_pending and vblank_copy_count 0) and loads default_palette_list into palette RAM (load_palette_list); hands back where it stopped writing.
comment load_palette_list Loads palette RAM (0x600000) from a list: a count, then entries of a source, a palette RAM offset and a copy mode, each source running to the next entry's: 0 copy_palettes_with_pen_0, 2 copy_palette_block, 4 repeat_palette_block (6 would be copy_palettes_with_pen_0 with pen 0 = 6; no list has it).
comment queue_vblank_copy Adds a copy to vblank_copies for the next VBLANK: source, dest (its top byte is how many times it is copied) and halfwords; vblank_copies_pending is cleared while the entry is written, then set.
comment repeat_palette_block Writes the 16-color blocks of the palette the list's next long points at, each as many times as its count, the counts being the size / 2 halfwords at source; moves palette_list past that long.
comment run_vram_script Runs a VRAM script from script, writing tilemap cells at dest: a byte 0x00-0x7F writes that word of vram_script_dictionary; 0x80-0xA7 are the commands of the vram_script_ functions (address, skips, fills, counts, raw bytes and words, page clears, columns, repeats); 0xAA ends. Hands back script and dest after it.
comment set_screen_mode Sets the screen: mode bit 0 wide (416 pixels: video_control bit 15, sprite_wide_screen); bit 1, flipped once more by setting_monitor_flip, flips the screen (video_control bit 9, sprite_flip 3); screen_mode keeps the result. Hands back video_control's address.
comment vram_script_bytes Command 0x8F: a count byte and a high byte, then count low bytes, each written as a cell with that high byte.
comment vram_script_clear_pages Command 0x98: an address halfword (dest = 0x300000 + it * 2) and a page count byte: clears count * 0x200 halfwords from there (fill_value 0).
comment vram_script_count_down Command 0x8C: a count byte and a word: count cells of word, word - 1, word - 2 and so on.
comment vram_script_count_up Command 0x89: a count byte and a word: count cells of word, word + 1, word + 2 and so on.
comment vram_script_end Command 0xAA's routine, which ends a script; run_vram_script returns by itself on it, so nothing calls this empty function.
comment vram_script_fill Command 0x86: a count byte and a word: the word in count cells.
comment vram_script_fill_down Command 0x9B: a count byte and a word: the word in count cells down a column, 0x40 bytes apart.
comment vram_script_fill_down_wide Command 0x9E: a count byte and a word: the word in count cells down a column of a 64-cell map, 0x80 bytes apart.
comment vram_script_fill_up Command 0xA1: a count byte and a word: the word in count cells up a column, 0x40 bytes apart.
comment vram_script_repeat Command 0xA4: a count byte and a word: writes the word count times to the same cell; dest does not move.
comment vram_script_set_address Command 0x80: dest = 0x300000 (video RAM) + the next halfword * 2.
comment vram_script_skip Command 0x83: dest moves by a signed byte of cells.
comment vram_script_skip_long Command 0xA7: dest moves by a signed halfword of cells.
comment vram_script_words Command 0x92: a count byte, then count words, one per cell.
comment vram_script_words_to_dictionary Command 0x95: as 0x92, each word also stored in vram_script_dictionary at dictionary_cursor, which wraps within 0x100 bytes.
comment animate_sign Cycles the current object's palette: every palette_delay frames palette_index steps on through the list at animate_sign.palette_list (a word with the last index, then the palettes), back to 0 after the last, and sprite_palette takes that entry.

A negative part sprite makes the wall invisible.

comment player_state_scene_thrown State 0x19 (game mode 0x0D), by scene_step: at each new step 0, 1 or 3 the player is lifted 0xA0 + 0x20 * kind and falls hurt (state 0xD, substate 2); at step 2 it is thrown (speed_z -0xE0000, speed_y 0x80000) with a cry. Between steps it stands on its floor, or stays hurt.
comment player_state_sinking State 0x33: sinks into the floor (floor_z and z 0x1D8 on block type 0x22, else 0x20; first moved 0xC toward its edge unless previous_state is 9) with its animation, an effect and sound 0x87; y + 1.5 a frame and after 0x1E frames z + 0xA000, cut at ground_clip_bottom. 0x20 under its floor: -8 health, respawn or dying.
comment player_state_stuck_on_object State 0x2C, stuck on an object, by substate: begin, wait, shake, jump out. Touched in a zone (flags 0x8000000) it goes back through check_player_contacts and player_dispatch_state.
comment player_state_swept_away State 0x28: caught in a swirl, the player circles chaser_object (turning toward it by swirl_turn_rate) while rising ever faster (speed up to 0xA00, speed_z + 0x280 a frame), flailing, with a cry; above the screen (-0x40) it loses 8 health: player_respawn, or dying (state 0x16).
comment player_state_trapped State 0x32: two trap objects (trap_flash_start, trap_start) and sound 0x21, the trapped animation, then a sign (kind 0x14) and the struggle: trackball speed above 0x100 fills escape_progress (else it drains), struggle frames by it; at 4 the player jumps out, bounces once and stands (state 0). comment add_play_time Adds game_frames to bookkeeping_play_time, carrying into bookkeeping_play_time_high.
comment compute_bookkeeping_crc compute_crc16 of the 0x40 bookkeeping bytes at data: hands back crc, and data moved past them.
comment compute_crc16 CRC-16 (polynomial 0x1021, the register seeded with DE BD EB) of count bytes from data, with 8 more shifts at the end: hands back crc, data past the bytes and polynomial (0x10210000). The EEPROM, bookkeeping, ranking and ROM checks use it.
comment compute_crc16_alternate_bytes compute_crc16's CRC of count ROM bytes from data, every other byte: each step adds 1 to the address, then 1 more to its low byte only, so from an odd address it reads the odd bytes across pages, from an even one it circles one 256-byte page. rom_checksums holds what it gives.
comment compute_crc16_strided Unused: compute_crc16's division by 0x11021 over count bytes from data, byte_gap + 1 apart, except that the first three bytes take the place of the DE BD EB seed (crc is shifted out unused); hands back the 16-bit remainder.
comment compute_eeprom_backup_checksum compute_eeprom_crc of the EEPROM backup copy from its write count on (0x36 bytes, its address handed over in current_object); hands back the CRC, for eeprom_backup_checksum.
comment compute_eeprom_checksum compute_eeprom_crc of the EEPROM block from eeprom_write_count to its end (0x36 bytes, the address handed over in current_object): hands back crc and polynomial.
comment compute_eeprom_crc compute_crc16's CRC of the 0x36 bytes at current_object, counted down in free_objects (both are left changed): hands back crc and polynomial (0x10210000).
comment eeprom_deselect Clears the EEPROM's chip select, clock and data lines (bits 5-7 of lines) on port_d and hands back lines.
comment eeprom_lock Sends the EEPROM the write-disable command (0), deselects it and turns interrupts back on.
comment eeprom_read_all Reads the EEPROM's 0x40 words (read command 0x80 + address) into eeprom_magic onward; interrupts stay off (eeprom_select). data is only scratch.
comment eeprom_read_all_and_enable_interrupts Unused: eeprom_read_all, then interrupts on.
comment eeprom_read_word Reads one EEPROM word: eeprom_send_command(command), then 0x12 clocks reading port_f bit 7, then eeprom_deselect; hands back the 16-bit word in data and the port D lines in lines.
comment eeprom_read_word_at Unused: reads the EEPROM word at address command (read command command | 0x80) and hands it back; interrupts on after.
comment eeprom_save Saves the settings: eeprom_write_count + 1, eeprom_checksum recomputed, the 0x40-byte block copied to eeprom_backup, then write enable (command 0x30) and the 0x40 words written (command 0x40 + address). Hands back the last command and words_left 0.
comment eeprom_save_and_lock eeprom_save, then eeprom_lock (write disable, interrupts on); command and words_left as eeprom_save hands them back.
comment eeprom_select Gets ready to talk to the EEPROM: hands back port D's value in lines and the port addresses (io_port_f, io_port_d) in port_f and port_d; turns interrupts off.
comment eeprom_send_command Starts an EEPROM command on port_d: lines low, a clock, chip select up, then the start bit and command's 8 bits, high bit first, each on the data line (bit 7) with a clock (bit 6); hands back lines.
comment eeprom_set_lines Writes lines to port_d (the EEPROM lines) and hands back data untouched.
comment eeprom_unlock Unused: sends the EEPROM the write-enable command (0x30), deselects it and turns interrupts back on.
comment eeprom_write_word Writes one EEPROM word: eeprom_send_command(command), then data's 16 bits, high bit first; chip select down for two clocks, then up, clocking until port_f bit 7 goes high (the chip is ready); deselects and hands back lines.
comment eeprom_write_word_at Unused: writes data to the EEPROM word at address command (write command command | 0x40); interrupts on after.
comment load_bookkeeping Loads the bookkeeping at power-on: reset when bookkeeping_rom_stamp is not this ROM's (rom_checksums + rom_checksum_ic8); else the block if its CRC matches bookkeeping_checksum (then copied to the backup), or the backup copied back, or a reset. Then power_on_time and power_on_frames_top from the bookkeeping.
comment load_settings Reads the EEPROM and checks it: a wrong eeprom_magic loads eeprom_defaults ('SEGA' also sets eeprom_write_count 0x64), another ROM's stamp or two bad CRCs reset the settings (default_settings), a bad CRC takes the backup, a bad backup is rewritten. Rebuilds also set moving_seat_dip from DIP 1, clear bookkeeping_rom_stamp, then save. crc is only scratch.
comment record_player_game Books a player's game at its end: bookkeeping_games + 1, its time (game_frames - join_time) added to bookkeeping_player_time and checked against the longest and shortest; when nobody is still playing (no player_status negative, 1 or 4) add_play_time. Then the checksum and the backup copy.
comment reset_bookkeeping Fills the bookkeeping block and its backup with bookkeeping_defaults, stamps both with this ROM's stamp (rom_checksums + rom_checksum_ic8) and updates bookkeeping_checksum.
comment update_bookkeeping_checksum Sets bookkeeping_checksum to compute_bookkeeping_crc of the bookkeeping block and hands the CRC back.
